continuity.arc_goal: Build Deterministic Simulation Testing (DST) infrastructure for Restate's partition processor (Phase 0-1 via seed-based StateMachine::apply simulation, Phase 1.5 via in-memory SimStorage, targeting TigerBeetle VOPR / FoundationDB levels), and fix issue #4566 (awakeable signal loss during leadership transitions) with proper TDD regression tests

progress_update.summary: Implemented DST Phase 1 with seed-based simulation test (1000 random commands via RocksDB TestEnv, 114ms). Built Phase 1.5 with SimStorage — in-memory storage implementation covering ~22 Transaction sub-traits in ~920 lines, proving out the storage layer abstraction for full PartitionProcessor simulation. Fixed issue #4566 by migrating append_signal and append_invocation_response from self_propose_and_respond_asynchronously to handle_rpc_proposal_command with new Action::ForwardAppendedResponse. Added proper TDD regression test at RPC handler level using MockActuator — verified FAILS on buggy code, PASSES on fixed code. All 156 worker tests pass, cargo clippy and fmt clean. Code review requested but interrupted.

constraints: All 22 Transaction sub-traits required for SimStorage — some methods (vqueue, budgeted reads) are unimplemented! stubs that will panic if hit during tests
request_id field is Option<T> for backward WAL compatibility — old journal entries deserialize to None
Strategy A (handle_rpc_proposal_command) introduces latency: +5-20ms for local loglet, +50-100ms for replicated — acceptable per prior analysis
restart_as_new_invocation legacy path NOT migrated — intentionally deferred (being deprecated in fleet upgrade past protocol V4)
append_invocation Appended mode NOT migrated — still uses self_propose_and_respond_asynchronously (orthogonal concern, deferred)
bilrost added as dev-dep to restate-worker for vqueue trait generic bounds
All tables are logical (2-byte KeyKind prefix) within single RocksDB CF per partition — no write amplification
StateMachine::apply is near-pure — no internal randomness or system time (enables determinism)
decisions: Phase 1.5 tests dedup + state machine layer via SimStorage — does NOT include full run_inner loop (Phase 2 will use Bifrost::init_in_memory + PartitionProcessor)

DST dedup test validates dedup behavior (correct both before and after fix) — does NOT reproduce response-layer bug. Test renamed to issue_4566_dedup_drops_old_epoch_self_proposal to reflect actual semantics

Proper TDD regression test at RPC handler level (not state machine level) — uses MockActuator, asserts self_propose_and_respond_asynchronously.never() and verifies handle_rpc_proposal_command receives embedded request_id
Single Action::ForwardAppendedResponse variant rather than per-command variants — all affected sites (append_signal, append_invocation_response) return Appended response
Custom seed-based command generation over proptest — proptest shrinking doesn't work well for stateful sequences with RocksDB state
SimStorage uses in-memory BTreeMap backend for fast Phase 1.5 testing — Phase 2 will use TestEnv with RocksDB
